# Wordmark

The gradnext logo — a lowercase text-only wordmark — rendered from the guideline artwork as inline SVG.

`Gradnext.Wordmark` · Brand

## Use

```jsx
<Gradnext.Wordmark />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Gradnext.Wordmark"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The gradnext wordmark, drawn from the guideline artwork. Never retype it.

## Props (WordmarkProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `"rhino" \| "white" \| "midnight" \| "ink"` | Ink: rhino on white, white on dark grounds, midnight for the small header mark, ink follows the theme. Default "rhino". |
| `height` | `number` | Rendered height in px; width keeps the 587:156 ratio. Default 32. |
